sampling: future-free interval Lipschitz bound L_i; require raw Psi_i>=L_i*control_dt+2e-7

detour.direction_method: exact feasible-polytope vertices; held direction support by LP

conditional_detour.semantics: The base sampled RA-DPCBF QP is default. The original chi-Gamma row is admitted only after a persistent feasibility-reserve, radial-braking, or stagnation trigger.

development_note: Copied method. Barrier, radius, MPC, input limits, chi-Gamma direction search, transport, reselection and strength are unchanged; only auxiliary activation and release lifecycle are conditional.
lifecycle_confirmation: Elapsed time between consecutive observed release predicates; first observation credits zero time.

goal_aware_design.scope: Only direction ranking and optional detour release are modified; original safety/radius/MPC and rollout termination unchanged.
goal_aware_design.ranking: Evaluate actual current candidate augmented-QP input using the nominal MPC plan, original horizon/weights, first prediction input replaced.
goal_aware_design.gamma: Feasibility and strength only; never used as a preference score.
goal_aware_design.cadence: Existing mpc_prediction_dt; switch spacing existing detour.tau_off.
goal_aware_design.candidate_count: mpc_horizon equally spaced tangent directions plus projected goal/nominal/held; polytope-vertex candidates only if stencil finds none.
goal_aware_design.release: Existing release dwell; near-goal base authority OR primary clear plus better base predicted goal progress and objective.
goal_aware_design.limits: Candidate rollout is a goal-cost heuristic, not a future safety certificate or an EVA reproduction.
